verdict.rationale:
ClickHouse is open-source, self-hostable via a single binary (curl install, clickhouse-local) and its Cloud offering explicitly supports exporting backups to your own cloud account and provides migration guides, all consistent with a no-lock-in exit path. However, the evidence never explicitly enumerates open export formats (CSV/Parquet/native) or a dedicated 'full data export' workflow beyond backups and migration guides.

missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported export formats (e.g. Parquet/CSV/Arrow) for full dataset export, and a hands-on/independent report confirming a full migration-out was actually completed without data loss.
